descriptionChirho: A secret plot or treasonous alliance against a ruler or established authority, the sole lexicographic sense of קֶשֶׁר. All occurrences describe political conspiracies: Zimri's conspiracy against Elah (1 Kgs 16:20), Athaliah's cry of 'Treason!' (2 Kgs 11:14), Shallum's conspiracy (2 Kgs 15:15, 15:30), Hoshea's conspiracy (2 Kgs 17:4), Isaiah's warning not to call everything a conspiracy (Isa 8:12), Jeremiah's report of conspiracy among Judah (Jer 11:9), Ezekiel's charge against the prophets (Ezek 22:25), and conspiracies in Chronicles (2 Chr 23:13, 25:27). Arabic فِتْنَةً/مُؤَامَرَةٌ (sedition/conspiracy), Korean 공모/음모/반역 (collusion/plot/treason), Spanish conspiración, Hindi षड़्यंत्र (conspiracy), German conspiracy/treason. The 'treason' rendering in 2 Kgs 11:14 is the same word used emphatically rather than a different sense. All clusters (including construct, suffixed, and articular forms) represent the same meaning with mere morphological variation.
